test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'PENCIL' is written as '1771771418' and 'ERASER' is written as '6204231024'. How will 'SHARPNER' be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed here is: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15de3128e581b71e1c2b4443913576e7f6ece2eda64ec5f300508174745e0fb9.png] 

In the above code, letters are given their positional value in increasing order, (addition of 1 for very next number.)

'PENCIL' is written as '1771771418'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7254865484b217000a92cd93f4a1f53002634780e6073243d7577c081db7bc0.png] 

And,

'ERASER' is written as '6204231024'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf2a578cfe77c6741c66a432d5e5ecc78a12d0e69363de41bc7ae27772b0e9ad.png] 

Similarly,

'SHARPNER'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e146febca9feb218462f038f95c4cb3e184b8521e0ba5765843a4289c9401792.png] 

The code for '**SHARPERNER'** is** '201042221201226'.**

Hence, the correct answer is** option(1)**
